source.reported_anchors: wj_h1_experiment.json; retained without relabeling H1 as calibrated

data_plane.location: virtual crest with hill absent; Fig.3, p.7 and Sec.3.1 pp.6-8
data_plane.assumption: identify the measured plane approximately with inlet; no upstream-fetch calibration
data_plane.consequence: imposed outer mean data at x=0 are not an independent validation; report flat development at x=2,4,6,8

missing_inputs.actual_K_H: evaluate digitized rms at physical z=d0+H_w; not the rounded near-wall anchor
missing_inputs.trace: epsilon_H=A(K)/H_w is dependent, never independently prescribed in conflict
missing_inputs.far_completion: C1 finite-depth tail to U=1 and assumed .003 rms per component at physical z=12.5; constant beyond
missing_inputs.classification: unmeasured completion assumptions, not experimental error bars or retuned WJ constants

roughness_calibration.height_rule: smallest H in [.375,.5,.75] containing at least three rough-case mean points above effective wall
roughness_calibration.h_s_rule: least squares finite-nu AWF U(r)=u_tau^2*J0(r), using measured completion K(H) and reported u_tau only
roughness_calibration.fitting_residuals: retain exact Linux case-design.json and completion summary
roughness_calibration.restrictions: no hill speed-up/reattachment fit; cube height, z0 and h_s remain distinct

boundary_roles.mode: OpenTunnelV1, production serial flat composite WJ Budget route
boundary_roles.inlet: physical finite-depth U,k,outer epsilon; no-slip ground corner wins; H epsilon owned by dependent trace
boundary_roles.outlet: prescribed full physical mean traction vector, zero for physical pilot; scalar zero outward diffusive flux
boundary_roles.pressure: traction fixes level; no redundant mean-pressure unknown/row or initial regauging; p/rho=pi-2k/3
boundary_roles.ceiling: physical z=20, impermeable slip, zero scalar diffusive flux for physical pilot; later sensitivity remains
boundary_roles.ground: no-slip, zero modeled k diffusive flux
boundary_roles.backflow: stop before commit if sampled outlet normal velocity < -1e-12; no clamp or scalar extrapolation

analytic_control.kind: separate Budget/WJ neutral reference, not measured-k completion
analytic_control.ceiling: impermeable, applied tangent +u_ref^2 and epsilon diffusive flux Cd*K^2/(sigma_epsilon*(Ztop-d0))

numerical_scope.spaces: Q3 velocity/scalars, regional continuous Q1 pressure, one shared U/k trace, outer-only epsilon
numerical_scope.temporal: IMEX1/PimpleSingleSweep, eta=0, one U/pressure/k/epsilon solve and one logical bound
numerical_scope.pilot: dt .02/.01 to T=.08; fresh compatible CP0 per dt
numerical_scope.frozen_target: T=8, one nominal flow-through of [0,8]; otherwise retain unreached target
numerical_scope.excluded: physical hill prediction, EP, WJ7 continuation, clipping/caps/forcing, sparse rewrite, 3D/MPI, LES/spectra
